pr_title: planner: fix column count mismatch error when push down Agg to UnionExec.
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/26554 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary: SQL gets an internal error: UnionExec chunk column count mismatch.
When pushing down Aggregate for Union, unionExec will use the children schema as itself.
Then the optimization columnPruner maybe try to prune the column of Aggregate, which wrongly modified the schema of Union. Because they use the same column slice...

We need clone the schema when building UnionExec.

### What is changed and how it works?

Proposal: [xxx](url) <!-- REMOVE this line if not applicable -->

What's Changed: 
Clone the schema for UnionExec.

issue_context.title: Internal error: UnionExec chunk column count mismatch
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->
```
use test;
drop table if exists IDT_HP24172;
CREATE TABLE `IDT_HP24172` (
  `COL1` mediumint(16) DEFAULT NULL,
  `COL2` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `COL4` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `COL3` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `COL5` float DEFAULT NULL,
  KEY `UM_COL` (`COL1`,`COL3`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin
PARTITION BY HASH( `COL1`+`COL3` )
PARTITIONS 8;
insert into IDT_HP24172(col1) values(8388607);
select col2 from IDT_HP24172 where col1 = 8388607 and col1 in (select col1 from IDT_HP24172);
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
```
mysql> select col2 from IDT_HP24172 where col1 = 8388607 and col1 in (select col1 from IDT_HP24172);
+------+
| col2 |
+------+
| NULL |
+------+
1 row in set (0.01 sec)
```

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
```
mysql> select col2 from IDT_HP24172 where col1 = 8388607 and col1 in (select col1 from IDT_HP24172);
ERROR 1105 (HY000): Internal error: UnionExec chunk column count mismatch, req: 2, result: 1
```

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
It can be reproduced on branch release-5.0, release-5.1 and master
The release-4.0 branch doesn't have the issue


It seems that `HashAgg` children caused the problem? (I don't know how to fix it 🤔)

- UnionStore does not have this problem
- Reproduced when using TiKV

Release 4.0 also has this problem, but doesn't throw error.
Because in release 4.0, UnionExec doesn't have the following check:
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/880c9b52fca2c712eae05b3593019b916f171d08/executor/executor.go#L1617-L1620
